reviews.text: STAY AWAY from Dog Day Club - Av. Vereador Jose Diniz, 2298!! It doesn't get a ZERO rating because Google doesn't allow it. The worst grooming service in the region, and very likely in São Paulo. They hurt my dog's eye and are only offering to reimburse the vet bill. Lack of trust, empathy, and love for animals. Is this the importance you give to the pets you care for?!

I would definitely board my dog ​​at this place again!

It was our first boarding experience, and our dog had never stayed so long anywhere else. It was a 5-day stay. They were sensitive enough to observe which group my dog ​​was most comfortable with. We had access to the security cameras. When it was necessary to contact someone, we received a response via WhatsApp or landline.

Advantages: there's an option for a bath on the last day of boarding, paid separately; check-in and check-out times are very flexible.
Terrible. There's absolutely no interest in serving the customer... Imagine the poor animals...
Excellent treatment of the animals, very attentive and patient staff with even the craziest dogs ;)
Best hotel and daycare for dogs! Extremely qualified staff and a super well-structured facility!
The staff are very attentive, the place is great for pets, and they take excellent care of the animals. Whenever I need to travel, my dog ​​always stays there.
I love the staff. They take great care of my dog ​​and he loves spending the day there.
My dog ​​is overjoyed when she goes there. We've never had any problems. And they even give the dog a quick dry bath if he's been too naughty and has a strong odor.
Extremely professional, yet gentle in their treatment of pets. They have excellent facilities and a top-notch veterinarian.
